verdict.why: Email logs are now also written to .wrangler/tmp/email in the project root, with no code change needed.

draft.detail: In addition to the system temp directory, a simple text email sent via Wrangler is also written to .wrangler/tmp/email/session/email-text/message-uuid.txt

test.error: FAIL: sent email text was not written under .wrangler/tmp/email in the project root

source.quote: In addition to the system's temp directory, logs for emails sent by workers are also written to a local temp directory defined by the calling process, e.g for an simple text email sent via Wrangler this is `.wrangler/tmp/email/<session>/email-text/<message-uuid>.txt`
